headline: 58% of enterprises net-add AI initiatives amid governance gaps
summary: Most organizations struggle with AI governance, ownership, and cost control.
details: Enterprises are expanding their AI portfolios at a rapid pace, with 58% reporting net growth in AI initiatives over the past 12 months. However, this growth outpaces their ability to govern and control AI, leading to a widening control gap.

The main issue is a lack of ownership and governance, with only 38% of organizations having a central team govern AI, and 20% having each platform team govern its own AI independently. This leads to 85% of organizations running multiple AI platforms, each claiming to be the primary AI layer.

As a result, 40% of organizations are confident they would detect a model drifting or failing in production, but only 10% have active monitoring and alerting in place. The rest rely on manual human review, which can be insufficient.
The control gap leads to financial and operational failures, with 49% of organizations citing shadow AI as a severe control failure, and 25% experiencing runaway 'infinite loop' agent bills.
caption:
Can enterprises keep up with AI growth? 58% report net growth in AI initiatives.

Enterprises are expanding their AI portfolios at a rapid pace, with 58% reporting net growth in AI initiatives over the past 12 months. However, this growth outpaces their ability to govern and control AI, leading to a widening control gap.

The main issue is a lack of ownership and governance, with only 38% of organizations having a central team govern AI, and 20% having each platform team govern its own AI independently. This leads to 85% of organizations running multiple AI platforms, each claiming to be the primary AI layer.

As a result, 40% of organizations are confident they would detect a model drifting or failing in production, but only 10% have active monitoring and alerting in place. The rest rely on manual human review, which can be insufficient.

The control gap leads to financial and operational failures, with 49% of organizations citing shadow AI as a severe control failure, and 25% experiencing runaway 'infinite loop' agent bills.

#AI #EnterpriseAI #Governance #Tech

Source: VentureBeat
